title: Synthetic survey responses

gates.name: n explicit and unit-defined
gates.evidence: unit `respondent_id` declared; primary analysis at the row level; n=105 across 1 outcome(s).

gates.name: missing data mechanism declared
gates.evidence: 3 variable(s) carry missing values and 3 have no declared mechanism.
issues: AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED: missingness mechanism for: satisfaction, visit_frequency, minutes_spent
gates.fix: record collection context and a justified assumption; a small missing fraction or an association screen cannot establish it.

gates.name: effect size accompanies p
gates.evidence: all 1 estimable tests carry an effect size with a 95% CI.

gates.name: uncertainty visible
gates.evidence: every descriptive statistic carries an SE, every comparison figure states its interval, and every prose p value sits beside a CI.

gates.name: multiple comparisons corrected
gates.evidence: only 1 test was estimable, so there is no family to correct.

gates.name: sensitivity tested
gates.evidence: 17 perturbation(s) ran across 1 outcome(s) (leave-one-group-out, block jackknife, extreme-value fence, strict complete cases) and every one agreed with the primary verdict at alpha=0.05. Appendix A1 reports them.

gates.name: no association-to-mechanism upgrade
gates.evidence: no forbidden construction appears outside a disclaimer (11 patterns checked across 318 lines).

gates.name: unknowns flagged
gates.evidence: every unknown the pipeline detected is written AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED and repeated in Appendix B (3 withheld decision(s)).

structural.detail: all 2 figure(s) carry title, caption and a three-part body
0 forbidden phrases in the writer's own scan

journal.label: Nature Portfolio
journal.reporting_standards: Nature Portfolio reporting standards + the 8 data-master statistical gates

every column above 5% missing carries a declared mechanism
every estimable test carries an effect size with a 95% CI
